name: Hive 1.14.1
notes: Fixes and polish: the sole user stays the Owner of their private Home workspace after an identity change (a GitHub sign-in or reset no longer leaves you unauthorized in your own workspace), Claude Code narration around tool calls stays on separate lines instead of running together, and messages, attachments and the sidebar get themed right-click menus (copy, quote, regenerate, open, copy path, rename).
